name: u64-basic
script:
create 0 0
create 1 1
point
create 1 2
create 2 1
create 1 2      # a duplicate pair
update 2 3 1
delete 3
delete 99       # missing
create 5 5      # reuses 3
ensure 10
get-or-create 1 2
get-or-create 7 7
delete 10
delete 9        # frees 9 and the free 8 under it
ensure 2        # exists
ensure 0        # cannot be reserved
update 4 0 0
delete 1
update 1 1 1    # missing
create 6 6
output: error Storage error: could not reserve link address 0: the store allocated 9 instead
